385.question: Match the identities: List I A. Difference of Squares B. Square of Sum C. Sum of Cubes D. Difference of Cubes List II 1. a² + 2ab + b² 2. a³ - b³ 3. a² - b² 4. a³ + b³
385.explanation: Difference of squares: a² - b²; square of a sum: a² + 2ab + b²; sum of cubes: a³ + b³; difference of cubes: a³ - b³.

388.question: Match the terms: List I A. Monomial B. Binomial C. Trinomial D. Polynomial List II 1. Many terms 2. One term 3. Three terms 4. Two terms
388.explanation: Monomial – One term; Binomial – Two terms; Trinomial – Three terms; Polynomial – Many terms.
